newsitem.title: POLAND: Prochem sees 1997 net up to PLN 4 mln.
newsitem.headline: Prochem sees 1997 net up to PLN 4 mln.

text.p: Polish engineering company Prochem SA expects to lift net profit this year to about four million zlotys from 3.4 million zlotys last year, the company's president said on Wednesday.
"We're estimating our profit at around four million zlotys...it's just a prediction at the beginning of the year, but our prediction for 1996 we hit exactly," Stanislaw Srokowski told Reuters.
He said the firm would lift sales to about 70 million zlotys from 46 million zlotys in 1996.

Srokowski said Prochem could be buoyed by cooperation with its 35-percent owner, Fluor Corp unit Fluor Daniel BV, for whom the Polish company could carry out construction projects in Europe, Northern Africa and the Middle East.
Srokowski said that for the time being there was no plan for Fluor Daniel to raise its stake in Prochem.
Fluor Daniel's current 35-percent stake in Prochem gives it 31.3 percent of shareholder votes.
